about: Every schema variant evaluated in the paper. kind=ladder: SchemaAdapter(k=arg), SCHEMA_K=10 (k=5 is native), run with SCHEMA_VARIANT=arg python -m eval.run_agentic; kind=spec: operators.compile_spec on data/specs/<arg>, run with SCHEMA_SPEC=benchmarks/synthetic/data/specs/<arg> python -m eval.run_agentic (class_*/random_neutral_*/anti_class_neutral_* use python -m eval.run_class_grouping); kind=hierarchy: HIER_ARM=<arg> python -m eval.run_hierarchy. Other spec files in data/specs (seeds r1-r4 of the random/anti-class groups, pred2/pred4, curryind, currypart, mg*) are exploratory arms not reported in the paper.
